Free all the way

Every sign-up is a cost

A free training brings people in, but it doesn’t earn anything on the day. Every sign-up costs time or money to win, and nothing pays it back until someone joins EPP weeks later.

A big jump

Free to $2,600 in one step

A Director who enjoyed your training but isn’t ready for EPP has nowhere to go next. She drifts, and you lose the chance to help her now and enrol her later.

Calendar risk

Calls before commitment

Without a small purchase first, you can’t tell who’s serious until the call itself. That means time on calls with people who aren’t ready, can’t invest yet, or don’t show.

Your program is proven. What’s missing is a $27 front door that pays for itself every day, and a path that turns small buyers into qualified EPP applicants.

Questions

Before you grab the playbook

Is this for me if I’m new to a Director role?

Yes. It works whether you stepped up last month or you’ve been leading for years and want to be seen as more strategic.

I barely have time. How long does it take?

The video training is 60 minutes. You can use the 3-sentence update in your very next meeting.

Is this the same as your free training?

No. The free training shows you the big picture. The playbook gives you the scripts, self-check and 30-day plan to put it into practice.

Why is it only $27?

Because the first step should be easy. Use the playbook, see the difference, and decide afterwards if you want to go deeper with me.

Ad creatives · Video scripts

Ad scripts: talking to camera

Same warm brick backdrop as your profile photo. 30 to 45 seconds each.

Script 1 · “The 3-sentence update”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Here’s how strategic leaders give an update in a senior meeting, in three sentences.”

Body

“Sentence one: the headline, what changed. Sentence two: what it means for the business. Sentence three: what you recommend, or what you need. No backstory, no apologising. Then stop talking.”

CTA

“I put the full framework, plus my meeting scripts, in the Executive Presence Playbook. It’s $27. Tap Learn more.”

Shot: talking to camera against the brick wall, each sentence appears on screen as text.

Script 2 · “Busy isn’t strategic”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Being the hardest-working person in the room isn’t the same as being seen as a leader.”

Body

“The Directors I coach who step into strategic roles don’t work more hours. They hand off the work that keeps them in the weeds, and spend that time on the thinking senior leaders actually notice.”

CTA

“The Executive Presence Playbook includes my delegate-it scripts. $27, instant access. Tap Learn more.”

Shot: talking to camera, on-screen text “busy ≠ strategic” with “strategic” highlighted in brick.

Script 3 · “Presence is a set of habits”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Executive presence isn’t something you’re born with.”

Body

“It’s a handful of habits: how you open a meeting, how you disagree, how you hold a pause. Learnable, practical, and something you can start working on tomorrow morning.”

CTA

“My presence self-check and 30-day plan are in the Executive Presence Playbook. $27. Tap Learn more.”

Shot: talking to camera, cut to a phone screen showing the self-check. Keep claims educational, no promises about promotions or pay.
